attrs.label: Ciphera Relay
attrs.heading: Transactional email that respects privacy.
attrs.body: The email backbone behind every Ciphera service. TLS 1.3 encryption, DKIM signing, and zero tracking — for verification codes, security alerts, and account notifications.

text.text: When someone tries to break into an account or a password needs resetting, speed matters. Relay hands verification codes, security alerts, and lockout notifications straight to the mail server — with TLS encryption on every hop it controls.

bullets.text: Suspicious login alerts and account lockout notices

items.title: Email authentication
items.body: Per-domain DKIM keys, strict SPF, and a DMARC reject policy over TLS 1.3 — authenticated end to end, with reverse-DNS configured for HELO compliance.

items.title: No tracking
items.body: No tracking pixels, no open or click monitoring, no recipient IP profiling, no third-party analytics — delivery metadata is retained 30 days, then permanently deleted.

text.text: No SDK, no proprietary API. Relay uses standard SMTP AUTH over port 587 with STARTTLS — it works with any language, framework, or email library. Each Ciphera service gets its own sender domain and DKIM key for clean provenance.

bullets.text: SMTP AUTH on port 587 (STARTTLS) or 465 (implicit TLS)
Per-service sender domains for email provenance
Works with Go, Node.js, Python, PHP — any SMTP client
Direct SMTP handoff for transactional emails
No proprietary SDK or API lock-in

attrs.label: 04 · Data residency
attrs.heading: Hosted in Switzerland. Deleted in 30 days.

text.text: Relay runs on Exoscale (CH-DK-2), under the Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP). Email metadata is retained for 30 days under contract performance basis, then permanently deleted. No marketing emails, no behavioral data, no profiling.

bullets.text: Admin UI bound to localhost only (SSH tunnel access)
Let's Encrypt TLS certificates with auto-renewal
Transactional only — marketing emails are never sent
